title: Senior Data Engineer - NorthTide
text: NorthTide is hiring a Senior Data Engineer in Amsterdam, Netherlands. You will own our lakehouse on AWS, build batch and streaming pipelines with Spark, Airflow and dbt, and model curated datasets in Snowflake for analysts and ML teams. We expect strong SQL and Python, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and an eye for cost and data governance. Hybrid: three days a week from our Amsterdam office, with relocation support inside the EU.

title: Senior Data Engineer - TidalWorks
text: TidalWorks is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the platform team in Amsterdam. You will replace a monolithic ETL estate with event-driven pipelines on Kafka and Flink, keep dbt models tested and documented, and run the stack with Terraform and Grafana. We work in English, offer a hybrid week in our Amsterdam office near Sloterdijk, and support GDPR-conscious data engineering practices.

title: Freie Stellen - TidalWorks

title: Analytics Engineer (m_w_d) - NorthTide
text: NorthTide is recruiting an Analytics Engineer in Amsterdam. In this role you turn raw events into trustworthy dbt models, define metrics with product managers and keep the Snowflake warehouse fast and affordable. Requirements: advanced SQL, Python, experience with Airflow orchestration and a habit of testing data. We offer a hybrid contract based in Amsterdam, a learning budget and 27 holidays. Apply through our careers portal.

title: TidalWorks is looking for a Streaming Data Engineer.
text: TidalWorks is looking for a Streaming Data Engineer in Amsterdam, Netherlands. You will design exactly-once Kafka pipelines, operate Flink jobs that feed the real-time pricing service, and work with the platform team on schema governance. We are looking for solid Java or Python, comfort with Kubernetes, and an interest in observability. The team is based in Amsterdam and works two days remote. Apply with a CV; no cover letter needed.

title: Data Platform Engineer - NorthTide
text: NorthTide is hiring a Data Platform Engineer for the Amsterdam office. You will look after the Airflow deployment, the Spark cluster and the Terraform modules that everything is built from, and you will be the first reviewer for pipeline changes. Experience with AWS, Python and infrastructure as code is required; Snowflake and dbt are a plus. Amsterdam-based hybrid role, 32 or 40 hours a week, with a clear on-call rotation.
